title: The density equals the multiplicity Hⁿ-a.e. on the carrier
statement: Let P, n ∈ ℕ, S ∈ 𝒟_n(ℝ^P) (GeometricCurrentOn univ n), and let R = (M, θ, ξ) be an integer multiplicity representation of S in ℝ^P (R : IMRep univ n with R.Represents S; M = R.carrier, θ = R.mult). Let Θ : ℝ^P → ℝ satisfy HasMassDensity S x Θ(x) for every x ∈ ℝ^P. Then Θ(x) = θ(x) (θ(x) ∈ ℕ cast to ℝ) for H^n⌞M-a.e. x, i.e. for almost every x with respect to μHE[n] restricted to R.carrier.
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (S : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) n) (R : IMRep (univ : Set (Euclid P)) n) (Θ : Euclid P → ℝ), R.Represents S → (∀ x : Euclid P, HasMassDensity S x (Θ x)) → ∀ᵐ x ∂((μHE[n] : Measure (Euclid P)).restrict R.carrier), Θ x = (R.mult x : ℝ)
